title: Transfer Bonus Ad
scenario: A social ad promises a huge points-transfer bonus but sends you to an unfamiliar domain.

answers.A: Enter your login and transfer points before the bonus ends.
answers.B: Check the offer on your bank or loyalty programme website.
answers.C: Share the ad with a friend and ask if they recognise the domain.
answers.D: Ignore the ad and use the issuer's saved contact route.

explanation: The unusual domain is the signal. Points bonuses should be confirmed by the issuer, not by an ad-controlled landing page.
proTip: Treat an unfamiliar domain as unverified, however large the bonus looks.
